author: Learn Linux TV
description:
Learn how to create a Linux Golden Image on Linode and use it to deploy secure, preconfigured VPS instances in minutes.

In this hands-on Linux tutorial, you’ll learn what a Golden Image is, why system administrators use them, and the best practices to follow when building one. We’ll prepare a reusable Linode image by installing updates, preinstalling essential packages, configuring Fail2ban, and converting the finished VPS into a deployment-ready template.

By the end of the lab, you’ll be able to launch new Linux servers from your Golden Image - saving time, improving consistency, and eliminating repetitive server configuration.
